3. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2) titled "payments-worker errors after v3.4.0 deploy" — the on-call engineer has been paged, with the summary noting the rollback to v3.3.0.

The service is back to a healthy state and the incident is tracked for follow-up on the root cause of the v3.4.0 regression.
